units.rhetorical_move: divides the framework into three sub-models

original_instantiations: the analysis runs from the individual to the nation to the world
the framework is split into three named sub-models

units.source_excerpt: We divided the framework into three sub-models.
units.reusable_pattern: Open by naming the split.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not merge the three.

units.rhetorical_move: says volatility originates from speculative demand

original_instantiations: speculative demand is called too maneuverable
transactional demand stays insufficient

units.source_excerpt: The volatility originates from speculative demand, while transactional demand stays insufficient.
units.reusable_pattern: Name a cause with originates from, then contrast it.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not blame both demands equally.

units.rhetorical_move: says the proportion will converge to a fixed range

original_instantiations: an equilibrium exists without outside factors
the proportion converges to a fixed range

units.source_excerpt: The proportion will converge to a fixed range.
units.reusable_pattern: State an equilibrium as a convergence to a range.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not claim a single point.

units.rhetorical_move: says more developed economies accept coexistence

original_instantiations: more than a hundred countries are substituted
the more developed and open ones accept coexistence

units.source_excerpt: The more developed and open economies will accept the coexistence of the two currencies.
units.reusable_pattern: Rank countries with the more, the more.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not treat every country alike.

units.rhetorical_move: says the government needs to regulate to some extent

original_instantiations: high liquidity motivates promotion
extra costs require regulation to some extent

units.source_excerpt: The government also needs to regulate the development to some extent.
units.reusable_pattern: Balance a motive with to some extent.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not drop the hedge.

units.rhetorical_move: says the form will become the mainstream

original_instantiations: volatility is assumed relatively low
the form becomes the mainstream of trade

units.source_excerpt: Under low volatility, the form will become the mainstream of trade.
units.reusable_pattern: Bind a claim to a hypothesis.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not drop the hypothesis.

units.rhetorical_move: says the tendency is oligopoly

original_instantiations: high liquidity and informatization arrive together
the industry tends toward oligopoly and the intermediary function disappears

units.source_excerpt: High liquidity will lead to an oligopoly tendency and the disappearance of the intermediary function.
units.reusable_pattern: Name an industry outcome with tendency and disappearance.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not claim the industry vanishes.

units.rhetorical_move: addresses national leaders and offers an intuitive impression

original_instantiations: the letter is addressed to national leaders
the proposal is designed to give an intuitive impression

units.source_excerpt: The proposal is designed to give an intuitive impression of the current development.
units.reusable_pattern: Open a policy letter with designed to give an intuitive impression.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not open with a demand.

units.rhetorical_move: says the trend is inevitable

original_instantiations: the model runs at three levels
it tries to explain an inevitable trend and the existing risks

units.source_excerpt: The model tries to explain the inevitable trend and the existing risk factors.
units.reusable_pattern: Soften a strong claim with trying to explain.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not drop the trying.

units.rhetorical_move: says so long as participation grows, fluctuation stabilizes
units.function: bind the remedy to a condition

original_instantiations: few trades now leave speculative demand far higher
so long as participation grows, the fluctuation grows more stable

units.source_excerpt: So long as participation grows, the fluctuation will become relatively more stable.
units.reusable_pattern: Bind a remedy with so long as.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not present the remedy as automatic.

units.rhetorical_move: says the market will automatically choose

original_instantiations: sellers and buyers must benefit
the market then automatically chooses one form or a long coexistence

units.source_excerpt: The market will automatically choose one form or a long coexistence.
units.reusable_pattern: Grant a mechanism with automatically.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not add an authority.

units.rhetorical_move: says it is worth noting that enforcement costs rise

original_instantiations: a lower tax rate enlarges the economy
enforcement costs also rise, so the government must weigh the pros and cons

units.source_excerpt: It is worth noting that enforcement costs will also rise, so the government must weigh the pros and cons.
units.reusable_pattern: Interrupt a benefit with it is worth noting that.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not let the benefit stand alone.

units.rhetorical_move: says capital will make up for neglected areas

original_instantiations: capital flows to more profitable places
previously neglected areas are made up for

units.source_excerpt: Capital will flow to more profitable places and make up for previously neglected areas.
units.reusable_pattern: Name a gain with make up for.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not claim every area gains.

units.rhetorical_move: says give full play while controlling the risk
units.function: close the letter with a balance

original_instantiations: the advantages should be given full play
the uncertainty and the illegal risk must still be controlled

units.source_excerpt: We should give full play to the advantages while controlling the uncertainty and the risk.
units.reusable_pattern: Close a letter with give full play while controlling.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not drop the while.

units.rhetorical_move: grants the advantages, then turns with on the other hand

original_instantiations: strong liquidity, high secrecy and low costs are granted
a lack of regulation follows on the other hand

units.source_excerpt: The currency has strong liquidity, but on the other hand it lacks regulation.
units.reusable_pattern: Grant three advantages, then turn with on the other hand.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not stop at the advantages.

units.rhetorical_move: says the question is whether benefits exceed costs

original_instantiations: the currency promotes trade better than a regulated sovereign currency
the question is whether the benefits exceed the costs

units.source_excerpt: Whether the benefits can exceed the costs is a topic of concern.
units.reusable_pattern: Frame a topic as whether benefits exceed costs.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not answer the question in the same sentence.

units.rhetorical_move: says last but not the least

original_instantiations: two tasks come first
the last is marked last but not the least

units.source_excerpt: Last but not the least, the regulatory objectives are explored.
units.reusable_pattern: Mark a final task with last but not the least.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not drop the marker.

units.rhetorical_move: says we drew lessons from a named model

original_instantiations: recognition is measured with a borrowed model
the lesson is drawn from that model

units.source_excerpt: We drew lessons from a named search model.
units.reusable_pattern: Credit a source with drew lessons from.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not present the model as original.

units.rhetorical_move: says the system makes up for a weakness

original_instantiations: a supranational institution is created
it makes up for the weakness of policy under a named model

units.source_excerpt: This will make up for the weakness of policy under the named model.
units.reusable_pattern: Claim a repair with make up for the weakness.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not claim the weakness vanishes.

units.rhetorical_move: says everyone is independent and free to choose

original_instantiations: the currency is widely distributed
everyone, including their country, is free to choose without interference

units.source_excerpt: Everyone is independent and free to choose without interference from others.
units.reusable_pattern: State a premise as freedom without interference.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not add a constraint.

units.rhetorical_move: says countries can trace every transaction at a higher cost

original_instantiations: the currency is anonymous
countries can still trace every transaction, at a higher cost

units.source_excerpt: Although the currency is anonymous, countries can trace every transaction at a higher cost.
units.reusable_pattern: Qualify anonymity with although and a higher cost.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not drop the cost.

units.rhetorical_move: says more assumptions will be added later

original_instantiations: the listed assumptions are called basic
other assumptions will be added for different models later

units.source_excerpt: These are the basic assumptions, and others will be added later.
units.reusable_pattern: Keep an assumption list open with added later.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not treat the list as closed.

units.rhetorical_move: asks what gave rise to the popularity
units.function: open a section with two questions

original_instantiations: one question asks what gave rise to the popularity
the other asks what impedes the function

units.source_excerpt: What gave rise to the popularity, and what impedes the function?
units.reusable_pattern: Open a section with two questions.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not answer both in the opening.

units.rhetorical_move: says money is just a piece of information in the ocean

original_instantiations: confirmation by a third institution is no longer needed
money is called a piece of information in the ocean

units.source_excerpt: Money is no longer circulating in banks; it is a piece of information in the ocean.
units.reusable_pattern: Keep the ocean image.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not flatten the image to a record.

units.rhetorical_move: says reasons above make it unable to fully perform

original_instantiations: trading demand will not be magnified indefinitely
the reasons above leave it unable to fully perform

units.source_excerpt: Reasons above make it unable to fully perform as a medium and a store.
units.reusable_pattern: Close a diagnosis with reasons above.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not claim total failure.

units.rhetorical_move: says the risk is expected to be greater

original_instantiations: the currency is not widely recognized
the quantity settled is small and the risk is expected to be greater

units.source_excerpt: When recognition is narrow, the risk is expected to be greater.
units.reusable_pattern: Tie risk to narrow recognition.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not state the risk as measured.

units.rhetorical_move: says the government weighs the pros and cons

original_instantiations: a wider tax base motivates promotion
extra costs and social losses require a weighing

units.source_excerpt: The government needs to weigh the pros and cons.
units.reusable_pattern: Name a tradeoff with weigh the pros and cons.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not resolve the tradeoff.

units.rhetorical_move: says every country has the motivation to adopt

original_instantiations: the universal currency is less volatile than each country's own
every country then has the motivation to adopt it in foreign trade

units.source_excerpt: Every country has the motivation to adopt the currency in foreign trade.
units.reusable_pattern: Derive a motive from a comparison.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not claim every country does adopt.

units.rhetorical_move: says the institution will reduce supply to regulate the deficit

original_instantiations: a deficit plus capital inflow signals pessimistic expectations
the institution then reduces supply

units.source_excerpt: A deficit with capital inflow leads the institution to reduce supply.
units.reusable_pattern: Tie a response to a signal.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not respond to a surplus the same way.

units.rhetorical_move: says capital will rapidly enter and occupy opportunities

original_instantiations: underdeveloped areas offer higher real rates
capital rapidly enters and occupies the opportunities

units.source_excerpt: Capital will rapidly enter and occupy the investment opportunities.
units.reusable_pattern: Dramatize a flow with rapidly and occupy.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not say the capital arrives slowly.

units.rhetorical_move: says the country will most likely accept fully

original_instantiations: one country has already given up issuing its own currency
its acceptance is assumed most likely to be complete

units.source_excerpt: One country's acceptance will most likely be complete.
units.reusable_pattern: Justify a benchmark with most likely.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not present the benchmark as measured.

units.rhetorical_move: says the attitude should be rather objective

original_instantiations: one country is the birthplace of many such currencies
its attitude should be rather objective

units.source_excerpt: Its attitude should be rather objective, so it supplies the threshold.
units.reusable_pattern: Justify a threshold with rather objective.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not claim the attitude was surveyed.

units.rhetorical_move: says without loss of accuracy the benefit is set to one

original_instantiations: the benefit is hard to calculate
it is set to one without loss of accuracy

units.source_excerpt: Without loss of accuracy, the benefit is set to one.
units.reusable_pattern: Simplify openly with without loss of accuracy.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not hide the simplification.

units.rhetorical_move: says the approximation is the best so far

original_instantiations: one coin stands in for the currency
many aspects are unsatisfactory, but it is the best approximation so far

units.source_excerpt: The proxy has many unsatisfactory aspects, but it is the best approximation so far.
units.reusable_pattern: Admit a proxy with unsatisfactory but best so far.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not call the proxy exact.

units.rhetorical_move: says the results are basically in line with expectations

original_instantiations: the sample covers only part of the countries
the estimates are basically in line with expectations

units.source_excerpt: The estimates are basically in line with expectations.
units.reusable_pattern: Hedge a fit with basically.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not claim an exact fit.

units.rhetorical_move: says the variables have significant economic implications

original_instantiations: three risk variables are statistically insignificant
they still have significant economic implications

units.source_excerpt: The variables are insignificant, but they have significant economic implications.
units.reusable_pattern: Rescue an insignificant result with economic implications.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not hide the insignificance.

units.rhetorical_move: says this part of the world will ensure independence

original_instantiations: leading economies take a welcoming stance
the region is printed with one letter missing

units.source_excerpt: This part of the world will keep its own independence while accepting the currency.
units.reusable_pattern: Keep the printed slip when quoting.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not correct the slip when quoting.

units.rhetorical_move: says it is better to accept the universal currency

original_instantiations: certain states grip their own money loosely
taking the shared currency suits their growth better

units.source_excerpt: It is better for their development to accept the universal currency.
units.reusable_pattern: Give a reason with it is better for.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not present the choice as forced.

units.rhetorical_move: says the share stabilizes regardless of the initial proportion

original_instantiations: the simulation varies the starting share
the share stabilizes at one level regardless

units.source_excerpt: The share stabilizes at one level regardless of the initial proportion.
units.reusable_pattern: Report an invariance with regardless.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not drop the regardless.

units.rhetorical_move: says the share declines rapidly once regulation is lost

original_instantiations: the supervising bank loses its capacity
the share declines rapidly, even below the start

units.source_excerpt: Once regulation is lost, the share declines rapidly.
units.reusable_pattern: Name a failure with once and rapidly.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not soften the decline.

units.rhetorical_move: says the lost password loses control forever

original_instantiations: verification still rests on two keys
a lost password loses control of the account forever

units.source_excerpt: A lost password loses control of the account forever.
units.reusable_pattern: Name an irreversible loss with forever.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not add a recovery.

units.rhetorical_move: says countries are often afraid of foreigners' control

original_instantiations: infant industries are the concern
countries are often afraid of foreigners' control

units.source_excerpt: Countries are often afraid of foreigners' control over domestic industries.
units.reusable_pattern: Name a fear with often afraid.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not claim the fear is universal.

units.rhetorical_move: says the capital fails to fully promote convergence

original_instantiations: capital entering less developed areas is mainly speculative
it fails to fully promote the convergence effect

units.source_excerpt: The capital fails to fully promote the convergence effect.
units.reusable_pattern: Qualify a theory with fails to fully.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not claim the theory is disproved.

units.rhetorical_move: says the models are more flexible and compatible

original_instantiations: acceptability is the core
the models are called more flexible and compatible

units.source_excerpt: The models are more flexible and compatible.
units.reusable_pattern: Claim an advantage with more flexible and compatible.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not add a third adjective.

units.rhetorical_move: says the preparations reflect the preciseness of logic

original_instantiations: two named theories are combined before the system is built
the order reflects the preciseness of logic

units.source_excerpt: The preparations reflect the preciseness of logic.
units.reusable_pattern: Praise an order with preciseness of logic.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not claim the logic is complete.

units.rhetorical_move: says the relationships are relatively loose

original_instantiations: the framework spreads wide
the links among the parts stay fairly slack

units.source_excerpt: The relationships among the sub-models are relatively loose.
units.reusable_pattern: Admit looseness with relatively.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not drop the relatively.

units.rhetorical_move: says the realistic foundation is relatively weak

original_instantiations: no such market operates anywhere yet
the grounding in reality is therefore fairly thin

units.source_excerpt: The market does not exist, so the realistic foundation is relatively weak.
units.reusable_pattern: Tie a weak foundation to a missing market.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not claim the model is useless.

units.rhetorical_move: says the risk is manageable

original_instantiations: recognition is widespread and inflation controls are strict
the risk is then called manageable

units.source_excerpt: With widespread recognition and strict controls, the risk is manageable.
units.reusable_pattern: Call a risk manageable only under stated conditions.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not drop the conditions.

units.rhetorical_move: says some factors have not been reflected

original_instantiations: future work names factors not yet in the model
the tense is written as have not been

units.source_excerpt: Some factors have not been reflected in the model and should be considered.
units.reusable_pattern: Keep the tense as printed.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not correct the tense when quoting.

units.rhetorical_move: numbers sources in brackets

original_instantiations: each source opens with a bracketed number
the heading is singular

units.source_excerpt: Sources open with a bracketed number under a singular heading.
units.reusable_pattern: Keep the bracketed numbering.
prohibited_generalizations: The citation list belongs to this paper and does not transfer.
